call_layer: ~/model-farm/farm.py — uniform call(name, input) + CLI: python3 farm.py <member> <input>; remote: farm_server.py HTTP shim on 127.0.0.1:8770 (POST /call), reached through an SSH tunnel
doctrine: The CPU/service tier of the farm pattern. The Oracle never sleeps and sits on the fleet's fast pipe, so this farm is a set of gauges other agents consult over the wire: digestion, judging, embedding, transcription. Slow per call is acceptable — callers are turn-structured. Nothing latency-critical, nothing GPU-shaped, nothing big belongs here; the relay's disk is stage-and-forward and every member is a replaceable artefact. The ONNX members stay warm inside farm_server.py; llm/whisper spawn per call by design. The LLM defaults to 2 of the 4 vCPUs (FARM_LLM_THREADS overrides) because this box also carries the fleet's tunnels.
